name: What factors determine if my roof needs repair or a full replacement?

mainEntity.name: What factors determine if my roof needs repair or a full replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Several factors influence whether a roof requires repair or replacement. These include the age of the roof, the extent of damage, the type of roofing material, and the condition of the underlying structure. A minor leak or a few missing shingles might only need a repair, especially on a newer roof. However, widespread damage, significant granule loss, soft spots, or a roof past its typical lifespan often indicate a need for replacement. Our assessment considers these elements to recommend the most cost-effective and durable solution for your DFW area home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Factors like roof age, damage extent, material type, and structural condition determine if repair or replacement is needed.
